children: Industrial engineering firm Smiths Group continues to face challenges but a medium-term recovery is on the cards, Jefferies analysts write. The research team highlights the current "messy" consensus on Smiths due to the impact of the Middle East conflict in John Crane, and slow U.S. construction in Flex-Tek. As such, the analysts need "more momentum" to consider taking a more positive stance on the stock. Jefferies cuts its price target on the stock to 26.75 pounds from 27.50 pounds, but keeps its hold rating. Smiths Group shares are up 0.9% at 25.59 pounds. (joseph.wilkins@wsj.com)
